summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FOUR new features added to Verbal WhatsApp CRM: (1) Password Reset self-service flow, (2) Login Rate Limiting, (3) Scheduled Broadcasts, and (4) Analytics page. All backend API tests passed (23/23). Frontend UI tests passed with all new features verified. Regression testing confirmed all existing features continue to work correctly.
